sources.statement: APC generates these files with proprietary vortex-theory software from propeller geometry. Wind-tunnel data are identified separately as the UIUC site.

Performance files estimate thrust, torque, and efficiency. Lift-drag inputs may be NASA TAIR, polar diagrams, or empirical minimum-drag notes. In-flight RPM and airspeed measurements are a separate design-evaluation practice, not this performance file.
